description: This file defines the EmployeeSalary entity class in PHP, including properties, ORM mappings, and accessor methods, representing employee salary data within a Human Resource Management System.

classes.name: EmployeeSalary
classes.description: Entity class representing employee salary information with ORM mappings, properties, and getter/setter methods, including relationships to Employee, PayGrade, CurrencyType, PayPeriod, and EmpDirectDebit.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the EmployeeSalary record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the EmployeeSalary record.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves the Employee entity associated with this salary record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with this salary record.

methods.name: getPayGrade
methods.description: Returns the PayGrade associated with this salary.

methods.name: setPayGrade
methods.description: Sets the PayGrade for this salary record.

methods.name: getCurrencyType
methods.description: Retrieves the CurrencyType used for this salary.

methods.name: setCurrencyType
methods.description: Assigns a CurrencyType to this salary.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Gets the basic salary amount as a string.

methods.name: getPayPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the PayPeriod associated with this salary.

methods.name: setPayPeriod
methods.description: Assigns a PayPeriod to this salary.

methods.name: getSalaryName
methods.description: Gets the name of the salary component.

methods.name: setSalaryName
methods.description: Sets the name of the salary component.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves any comments associated with this salary record.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Adds comments to this salary record.

methods.name: getDirectDebit
methods.description: Returns the direct debit details linked to this salary.

methods.name: setDirectDebit
methods.description: Sets the direct debit information for this salary.
